items.original_title: BRICS bloc agrees on joint declaration, sources say
items.rss_summary: NEW DELHI, Sept 12 (Reuters) - The BRICS group of countries has agreed on a joint declaration, which is unlikely to name any country but will condemn unilateral war by any country, four sources told Reuters on Saturday.   The bloc, which includes Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates, is holding its annual summit in New Delhi this weekend.

items.title: Two uniforms, one deadly morning: How this firefighter and former soldier is reflecting on 9/11
items.original_title: Two uniforms, one deadly morning: How this firefighter and former soldier is reflecting on 9/11
items.rss_summary: Twenty-five years after the terror attacks of Sept. 11, 2001, Shawn Matheson recalls viewing them through two different lenses: as a firefighter in Mississauga, Ont., and as a Canadian reservist. The tragedy would take him to funerals at Ground Zero, foreshadow the war in Afghanistan and reveal the lasting emotional cost borne by soldiers and first responders alike.

items.title: Trade 'war' or not, are Canada and the United States now dug in?
items.original_title: Trade 'war' or not, are Canada and the United States now dug in?
items.rss_summary: Jamieson Greer, the U.S. Trade Representative, might not like to think of it as a trade 'war.' And it seems now that it could be several more months before hostilities are reduced, let alone ceased.

Retrieval operations will continue as more bodies are still inside the MV June Aster, coastguard officials said without providing a count. There were 43 survivors among the 132 people on board.
